    How to read this: older videos have had more time to collect views, so raw view counts favour them. Views per day (views ÷ days since upload) normalises for this. The sample contains a fixed number of search results per time window, so the number of videos per year shows the sampling design, not the size of YouTube's market.

    Read-only snapshot. This page shows the data as collected by the prototype. The live version, which runs locally, can collect new data and refresh statistics through the YouTube Data API.

    1 · YouTube API key

    The key is stored only locally in .env. Create one at Google Cloud Console → APIs & Services → enable “YouTube Data API v3” → Credentials → API key.

    2 · Collect data

    Searches done
    Quota today

    One search costs 100 units; video and channel details cost 1 unit per 50 items. The default quota is 10,000 units per day and resets at midnight Pacific Time. Collection resumes where it stopped.

    Dataset & data quality

    Export dataset as CSV

    Method

    • Sampling: each search term is run with search.list (order = relevance, type = video, relevanceLanguage = en) once per time window, so older videos are represented, too.
    • Details: videos.list (statistics, duration, tags) and channels.list (subscribers).
    • Topic: first supplement keyword found in the title (e.g. “creatine”, “beet”, “gel”). If the title names none, the topic of the search term is used; otherwise “General / Stacks”.
    • Reach = average views per video. Engagement rate = (likes + comments) / views × 100, per video, then averaged. Videos with hidden likes are excluded from engagement metrics.
    • Views per day = views / days between upload and data collection.
    • Supplement filter: the title names a supplement topic, or title/tags contain “supplement”, “powder”, “capsule”, “dose”, … Removes off-topic results such as workout videos returned for “pre workout for running cardio”.
    • Endurance filter: title, tags or description mention running, marathon, endurance, cardio, triathlon, cycling, …
